chapters.label: Title night
chapters.text: Udine, 2023. One point makes Napoli champions. Their defender Kim Min-jae is called the Monster. Here’s how he defends. Udinese look for their striker… but Kim steps in first!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Kim watches the passer’s eyes. He sees the pass coming, so he steps out early… in front of the striker!

chapters.label: The break
chapters.text: Ball stolen! Kim lifts his head and hits a long pass at once. Napoli break away! It ended one–one: champions!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: So remember: watch the passer’s eyes, and step in front of the striker to steal it!
